name: salaryslip-backend
description: Express + MongoDB API for the SalarySlip payroll app

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/server.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --banner:js="const crypto = require('node:crypto'); if (typeof globalThis.crypto === 'undefined') globalThis.crypto = crypto; const OrigTD = globalThis.TextDecoder; if (OrigTD) { globalThis.TextDecoder = class extends OrigTD { constructor(enc, opt) { if (enc && String(enc).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '') === 'ascii') { super('utf-8', opt); } else { super(enc, opt); } } }; }" --outfile=dist/server.cjs --format=cjs && node scripts/copy-pdfkit-data.mjs
scripts.build: esbuild src/server.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --banner:js="const crypto = require('node:crypto'); if (typeof globalThis.crypto === 'undefined') globalThis.crypto = crypto; const OrigTD = globalThis.TextDecoder; if (OrigTD) { globalThis.TextDecoder = class extends OrigTD { constructor(enc, opt) { if (enc && String(enc).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '') === 'ascii') { super('utf-8', opt); } else { super(enc, opt); } } }; }" --outfile=dist/server.cjs --format=cjs && node scripts/copy-pdfkit-data.mjs && pkg dist/server.cjs --targets node18-win-x64 --output ../SalarySlip/src-tauri/binaries/backend-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe
